data.action: 单手拿着冰淇淋盒，另一手执小勺微红着脸递向视角，眼神别扭又可爱
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, sweet casual date view
data.description: 【两仪式 · 便利店门前的草莓冰淇淋】夏夜晚风习习的街角便利店外，两仪式身穿便服毛衣和风衣站在路灯下。她手里捧着一盒小巧的草莓味哈根达斯冰淇淋，拿着塑料小勺挖了一小块放入口中，双眼满足地微微眯起，像一只尝到甜头的小猫。随后她有些别扭地把勺子挖好递到你面前——「喏……只准吃一小口，剩下的都是我的。」
data.lighting: 便利店透明落地窗投出的明亮灯光与路灯
data.location: 灯光温暖的24小时便利店门外长椅旁
data.promptProse: Outside the corner convenience store on a breezy night, Ryougi Shiki tastes strawberry ice cream, then extends a small plastic spoon toward her companion. Her cream turtleneck, charcoal coat, red plaid scarf and tall boots follow the current outfit. The eye-level cowboy view includes the bright shop windows and street curb. Store light illuminates her satisfied expression and ice-cream carton, while the streetlamp gives the coat's outer edge a warmer highlight.
data.title: 两仪式 · 便利店门前的草莓冰淇淋
